_comment: UNITE training standard v2 - REAL EARTH (RULES.md R35-R43, docs/TRAINING-ENV.md). The envelope is set by the physical world a policy may meet (indoor/outdoor floors, real motors, real sensors, real latency), not by any game. Every portable policy trains across all of it; every app world stays inside it; a robot policy additionally proves itself against the calibrated twin and the real robot (tier 'robot'). Machine-checked by tools/check_training.py. Change only with an envelope_version bump.

earth._comment: Fixed physical constants. Local g varies 9.78-9.83 m/s^2 (<0.3%), far inside the mass randomisation, so it is pinned.
earth.air_drag: neglected (< 1% of body forces below 2 m/s)

randomisation_min._comment: A card's declared range must CONTAIN each range. Sources: rubber feet on wet tile (~0.3) to dry concrete/carpet (~1.5); battery and accessory payloads; motor torque sag with bus voltage; gearbox friction spread; measured DDS + Jetson latency (10 ms) plus jitter; real IMU gyro bias; door thresholds, cables and ramps.

obs_noise_min_std._comment: At least the real sensor noise, with margin (R1 encoder 0.0012 rad, IMU 0.003 rad measured in sim_calibration.yaml).

world_limits._comment: Every app world (game or twin) must be a piece of real Earth inside the trained envelope, with margin.

reward._comment: Core terms every locomotion-tier skill must have and log separately. Weights free, signs fixed. App-specific terms are task_*. torque and joint-limit terms are core because real motors overheat and real joints hit stops.

eval._comment: Every portable policy is evaluated at each corner of the envelope, on its own creature. All must pass.

robot._comment: Tier 'robot': the extra evidence before an ONNX may go to a physical robot. Only a creature whose contract has a hardware block (R21). Deployment itself always goes through the owner app's deploy gate, never by copying the file.
